nodes.label: Thin in-house i18n layer (no next-intl / i18next)
nodes.rationale: The Next 16 guide's own server-only dictionaries + proxy negotiation pattern covers the need; proxy.ts already carries CSP/CSRF logic so a second middleware framework risks conflicts, and 6 locales × ~1.2K keys does not justify a runtime ICU engine.

nodes.label: resolveLocale() 5-step chain
nodes.rationale: cookie > users.locale > org default_locale on public pages > Accept-Language > en; the org-default rung means a Chennai club's public pages read Tamil for every visitor unless the visitor picked otherwise.

nodes.label: Flat dot-key dictionaries by namespace
nodes.rationale: Key style surface.area.slug with no dynamically built keys so every key is grep-able; a generated dictionary-keys.d.ts from en gives typed t() keys.

nodes.label: I18nProvider slice (client bundle discipline)
nodes.rationale: Client components normally receive strings as props from server components; interactive-heavy trees get only their surface's namespace slice so whole dictionaries never ship to the client.

nodes.label: No URL restructure in phase 1; marketing-only prefixes in phase 2
nodes.rationale: 87 slug-routed console pages are low SEO value and high risk, so /{lang} prefixes go only where SEO pays; unprefixed stays en canonical to avoid redirect churn for existing links.

nodes.label: Noto Devanagari/Tamil fonts as a hi/ta release blocker
nodes.rationale: OG images and the pdfkit poster embed no font today, so hi/ta share cards render tofu; Barlow Condensed has no hi/ta glyphs so the display face falls back to Noto — a deliberately recorded personality compromise, and Latin locales pay zero payload.

nodes.label: lib/format.ts Intl wrappers
nodes.rationale: Replaces ~31 files hardcoding en-GB/en-CA/en-US; currency SELECTION logic is untouched — only display formatting localizes — and competition timezone stays authoritative for schedule display.

nodes.label: Stable error codes, client-side translation
nodes.rationale: The v1 envelope already carries stable codes, so the client maps code → errors.* and falls back to the server message; no server-side translated strings in v1 responses, API consumers get English plus codes.

nodes.label: i18n out of scope (binding)
nodes.rationale: User content, RTL, locale-specific FX, API reference translation and per-locale PWA screenshots are excluded; slugify() stays ASCII.

nodes.label: users.locale + orgs.default_locale migration
nodes.rationale: Public registration captures the resolved locale onto the registration row because recipients often have no user account; email builders then take a required locale param with en fallback.
